original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

allowed_variations: Choose one tape, precision, hosting or restoration lemma.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.

actual_scope: Falsify injectivity of a coarsest-compatible target-adaptive precision policy on the actual pinned PR628 leaf, and prove an exact residue-translation criterion for policy invertibility.
scope_change_reason: Narrow the uniform-transfer precision/restoration card to an explicit proposed two-grid compiler policy. Prior PR1451 changes precision between forward and inverse; this result proves that target-based forward selection itself loses information.
bottleneck_link: An adaptive arithmetic compiler cannot infer reversibility from each fixed-grid leaf being reversible; injectivity or retained branch information must be accounted for before any transfer.
stop_rule: Stop after a source-bound admitted collision, exact policy classification and same-grid/stored-branch controls; no native compiler or selected-frontier change.
evidence: Actual PR628 leaf collapses target0 and1/32 to-5/16. The proof gives all integer collision pairs and a general residue-permutation criterion. Verification covers387 actual collisions,1161 fixed-grid inverses,774 stored-branch inverses and3412 residue policies.

open_questions.question: Can a useful target-adaptive policy preserve injectivity without a branch transcript?

open_questions.first_step: For a proposed finite-residue policy, verify its translated residue map is a permutation and prove that the actual increments match for every admitted source.
open_questions.blocked_by: Source-conditioned increment classification and any branch storage/erasure cost remain unproved.
